maria: Quick heads-up — there's a docs PR to migrate the streaming SDK snippets to the new async iterator API. PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123|#4123>

maria: TL;DR: changes are small but affect Python async example, TS streaming, and the Go channel snippet. Also pagination token name changed (next_page -> next_cursor) so we need to update examples that parse list responses.

jon: I can take the Python async example. What's the exact new idiom we want to show?

maria: Thanks — new pattern is the async iterator on .stream() instead of callbacks. Example we want in the chat streaming section:
```python
async def stream_chat():
    async with RedwoodClient(api_key=... ) as client:
        resp = client.chat.stream(model="redwood-1.1", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize Q1"}])
        async for chunk in resp:
            # chunk.text / chunk.delta depending on chunk type
            print(chunk.delta, end="", flush=True)
```
maria: Note: show how to handle completion vs delta in the loop. Short note about graceful cancellation if user closes stream.

kevin: I'll update the TS example. Will follow the for-await pattern. Proposed snippet: 
```ts
const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: "redwood-1.1", messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Summarize Q1" }] });
for await (const part of stream) {
  if (part.delta) process.stdout.write(part.delta);
}
```

alex: For Go we currently show a synchronous callback style. New example should use the stream iterator and a channel read so it looks idiomatic. Rough: 
```go
stream, err := client.ChatStream(ctx, &chat.Request{Model: "redwood-1.1", Messages: msgs})
if err != nil { return err }
for {
    chunk, ok := stream.Recv()
    if !ok { break }
    fmt.Print(chunk.Delta)
}
```

alex: I'll also add a short snippet showing context cancel to stop the stream.

maria: Important: pagination token rename. In the Lists & Pagination doc we currently parse "next_page". Backend now returns "next_cursor". Update code examples and the fetch loop in both JS and Python.

jon: I'll grep for next_page in docs and open a follow-up PR for link fixes. Found ~6 occurrences.

kevin: FYI the streaming helper in the TS SDK changed the return type: it now yields objects with { delta?: string, done?: boolean, meta?: {} } — will add comment lines in the snippet.

docs-bot: CI note — docs build for PR #4123 passed lint but failed snippet tests on go example (timeout).

alex: I saw that, test harness was hitting network. I'll push a mock-based example and re-run.

maria: Action items:
- jon: update Python snippet + add short migration note (how to cancel) — target EOD
- kevin: update TS snippet + comment on delta/done — target tomorrow AM
- alex: update Go snippet, add mock test, fix timeout — target tomorrow
- jon: follow-up PR to replace next_page -> next_cursor across repo after this merges

jon: ack, taking python + grep PR.
kevin: ack, will update TS and add a one-line changelog entry in the snippet file.

alex: ack, will add mock and push fix.

maria: If anyone wants to pair briefly on wording for the migration note ping me in #docs. I'll review the PRs once they're up. :raised_hands:

docs-bot: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123|PR #4123> updated — reviewers: @maria, @jon, @kevin.

jon: opened follow-up PR for the next_cursor search/replace: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4124|#4124>. Small changes only.

maria: perfect. Thanks all.
